# DottedIP <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
DottedIP:String IP:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IP` | In | Int32 | required | The address as a whole number, with the first part in the highest byte. |

**Returns:** An address as text, with its four parts separated by dots.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print DottedIP$($7F000001)
Print DottedIP$($C0A80164)
```

```text
127.0.0.1
192.168.1.100
```
